title: Humanoid HUB esp aimbot fov
features:
🌟 HUMANOID HUB V7.5 [UNIVERSAL ESP & AIMBOT] 🌟
The Ultimate Combat Suite for FPS & Action Games (Max FPS Optimized)

Humanoid Hub V7.5 guarantees 0% FPS Drops thanks to its built-from-scratch "Event-Based" scanning engine. Unlike classic cheats, it doesn't drain your CPU; it runs smooth as butter in the background. It features custom Velocity Prediction and Dynamic Wallcheck for the ultimate tactical advantage.

🎯 PREMIUM AIMBOT FEATURES
Sticky Hard-Lock: Once the aimbot locks onto a target (Right Click), it never flickers or switches targets even if someone else crosses your line of sight. It holds on until the enemy is dead!

Velocity Prediction: When the enemy is running or jumping, the aimbot doesn't lock onto where they are; it calculates their velocity and locks onto where they will be (0.045 prediction multiplier) for pinpoint accuracy.

Wallbang Supported: Even if your locked target goes behind a cover, the aimbot doesn't drop the lock. Works flawlessly for wall-banging.

Right-Click (RMB) Integration: No need to mess with keyboard binds. Just press and hold your Right Mouse Button to lock on like a laser.

👁️ DYNAMIC ESP (VISUAL SYSTEM)
Smart Color Shifting: Enemy boxes turn Red when they are hidden behind a wall, and glow Green the moment they are exposed and shootable.

Locked Target Highlight: The box of the enemy you are currently locked onto instantly turns Neon Cyan, so you know exactly who you are targeting in the middle of chaos.

Detailed Intel: Displays the enemy's health with a dynamic color-shifting bar (Green to Red) and their exact distance (in meters) with a clean, pure white text font.

⚙️ SYSTEM & OPTIMIZATION (ZERO LAG)
Lite-Fullbright: Doesn't blind you with cheap, pure-white screens. It removes shadows and fog, illuminating dark corners like it's broad daylight without straining your eyes.

Custom Dot Cursor: Prevents the game from hiding your mouse when the menu is open. A sleek, Gojo-Purple dot cursor appears on your screen, allowing you to navigate the UI effortlessly.

Event-Based Scanner: Doesn't freeze your PC by constantly scanning the entire map. It only triggers when a new player spawns. Perfect for low-end PCs.

Sleek Watermark: A minimalist UI panel on the right side of your screen showing cheat status, aimbot bind, and active features.
